results.title: Wuxi cadastral survey and mapping procedure
results.note: Says city publicly displays cadastral region/subregion and parcel map data free; users can locate by certificate, unit number, parcel code or address and view/download parcel maps.

results.title: Wuxi online cadastral query FAQ
results.note: Confirms online electronic cadastral map lookup through Jiangsu government service, app and official account.

assessment: Strong official public-query lead: Wuxi allows free parcel map lookup/download using native parcel identifiers and address. It may serve rendered map/document outputs rather than anonymous vector geometries; vector exact-ID support remains unverified.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
